notes: [P1] missing test: the brief says the difficulty row must sit clear of the Start button and the start steps. test/difficulty-choice.test.js only checks for overlap with START_BUTTON and between the three buttons. Nothing checks that the row at CANVAS_HEIGHT-36 stays below the last START_STEPS line, which render.js draws at hintY + 38 + 22*i. If the hint or steps move, or more steps are added, the text could run into the buttons without any test failing.
[P2] style: render.js inserts DIFFICULTY_BUTTONS into the hud.js import between START_BUTTON and hudModel, which breaks the list's alphabetical order. src/main.js keeps its import list in that order.
